living_cost_source_basis.description: Oxford's own published estimate: GBP 1,475-2,175 per month for the 2027-28 academic year. Oxford does NOT publish a single annual figure -- estimated_living_costs_annual is left null rather than calculated, per instruction. Students are typically in Oxford ~6 months/year across three 8-week terms, but Oxford's own guidance suggests budgeting over a 9-month period; see 03-normalized/records.json derived_cost_estimates for an EvidaPath-calculated annualized range built from this figure, kept clearly separate from this source fact.

source_records.excerpt: A*AA, including A*A in Maths and Further Maths if available (in any order). International Baccalaureate: 39 (including core points) with 766 at HL (the 7 must be in HL Mathematics). Advanced Highers: AA/AAB with an A in Mathematics. UCAS code G400. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to at least one online interview. 3-year average (2023-25): 21% interviewed, 7% successful, 55 places available.
